title: Sect Tyranny
next_chapter_hook: Just as the Grand Elder was about to leave, his gaze suddenly pierced through the crowd, landing directly on Chen Ji's position—and in those eyes was a strange hint of familiarity, as if they had known each other long ago.

text.content: As dawn broke, an ominous gloom settled over the Golden Hall in the imperial city. The secret decree that the Crown Prince had entrusted to Chen Ji before falling into a coma now lay quietly in Chen Ji's sleeve, like a burning flame that scalded his restless heart. The 'greatest secret of imperial succession' mentioned in that decree was somehow connected to the Eye of Heavenly Way—a forbidden matter that even an existence surpassing all things would fear. What on earth could it be?

dialogue.content: (Thinking to himself) The Crown Prince sure made a huge gamble... Something even the Eye of Heavenly Way fears—what exactly is hidden in that secret decree? Unfortunately, this is not the time to check it.

text.content: At this moment, the city's protective formation above the imperial city suddenly violently trembled. An incomparably domineering aura rolled in from the northern horizon, like an awakened ancient giant beast, wantonly trampling on the laws of heaven and earth. Dozens of formation guards simultaneously grunted in pain, spitting blood and flying backward. The white marble steps before the Golden Hall were instantly dyed a startling crimson.

dialogue.content: (Standing beside Chen Ji, coldly said) Here they come. The Xuanwu Sect Grand Elder personally made the trip—it seems the imperial city is destined to face a change today.

text.content: From the billowing dust, a tall and dignified figure slowly descended. Sima Jingtian, the Grand Elder of the Xuanwu Sect, stood with hands clasped behind his back, his aura as substantial as a mountain pressing down, enveloping the entire imperial city. One hand behind his back, he casually raised the other, pressing gently toward the crumbling protective formation.

dialogue.content: (Eyes narrowing, whispered) Crushing the imperial city's protective formation with a single hand... This old monster's strength has advanced again.

text.content: With a thunderous roar, the protective formation shattered on command, dissolving into countless light specks. Dozens of formation guards simultaneously spat out blood, collapsing weakly to the ground. Though the imperial city's forbidden army was vast in number, they trembled under this pressure, lacking even the strength to grip their swords. The dignity of this great dynasty shattered completely in this moment.

dialogue.content: (Face livid, fists clenched) They... how dare they!
(Gripping Han Lie's shoulder, voice low) Don't act rashly. If you charge up there now, you're just seeking death.

text.content: Sima Jingtian surveyed his surroundings, his gaze filled with contempt. He slowly walked toward the unconscious Crown Prince, gazing down at that pallid face, then suddenly sneered: 'The dignified heir to the dynasty, and he can't even withstand a single move of mine? Laughable, truly laughable!' His voice echoed before the Golden Hall, each word like a knife cutting into the hearts of the dynasty's ministers.

dialogue.content: (Body slightly trembling, voice pressed low) He's right... The dynasty, before the sects, is truly helpless. But I absolutely cannot tolerate him humiliating the Crown Prince like this!

text.content: Sima Jingtian straightened up, his gaze sweeping across the ministers, a mocking curve forming at the corner of his mouth: 'Do you think this throne was given to you by whom? It was merely a discarded pawn we, the Xuanwu Sect, cast aside. Without the support of our three sects, you are nothing!' His words landed like slap after slap, making the dynasty's ministers flush with embarrassment, yet no one dared to utter a sound in protest.

Chen Ji concealed himself within the crowd, appearing to cower in fear, though his eyes blazed like torches. He quietly activated the Tianji Record Fragment, wanting to probe Sima Jingtian's secrets—but in that instant, his pupils abruptly constricted. Under the Tianji Record's vision, Sima Jingtian's body was actually wrapped around by a bizarre aura, one that... bore a subtle resonance with the fluctuations of the Eye of Heavenly Way, yet was deeper, more ancient.

dialogue.content: (Heart surging like mighty waves) The aura on this old monster... Something's wrong! Even more ancient than the Eye of Heavenly Way? In all the records of the Tianji Record, such an existence has never been recorded. Who is he? Or rather... what stands behind him?

text.content: At this moment, Sima Jingtian's gaze suddenly swept across the crowd, lingering on Chen Ji for an instant. That look carried a hint of inexplicable amusement, as if he had already discovered something. He did not expose it, simply withdrawing his gaze and turning to leave.

choice.prompt: Sima Jingtian is about to depart, the dynasty's dignity utterly lost. What will you do at this moment?

choices.description: Suppress the urge to strike, secretly noting this debt. Today's humiliation, I shall repay a hundredfold in the future.
choices.visible_cost: The dynasty's face is completely swept away, no one dares to speak
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, lay the groundwork for future counterattack
choices.risk_hint: If he perceives my intentions, it may bring death

text.content: Chen Ji pressed down hard on Han Lie, who wanted to charge out, his knuckles white from exertion. The flames of humiliation burned in his chest, but he understood more clearly—that for now, enduring is for a more ruthless counterattack in the future. Sima Jingtian, your arrogance today, I will make you repay with the entire Xuanwu Sect.
Han Lie turned to look at Chen Ji, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes. This 'waste' of a junior brother, was actually more capable of bending and adapting than he, the genius?

choices.memory_label: 隐忍蓄势_陈机按住韩烈

choices.description: Seizing the chaos to quietly lay contingencies, using the Tianji Record to peer into his weaknesses, planting a lethal seed for future counterattack.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key weakness intelligence on Sima Jingtian
choices.risk_hint: Using the Tianji Record may be detected by other existences

text.content: Chen Ji quietly reached into his sleeve, fingertips touching the yellowed Tianji Record fragment. A thread of Heavenly Fate power surged out, sketching a vague trajectory in the depths of his pupils—he saw it! Sima Jingtian's fatal point was hidden beneath that seemingly unchallengeable tyranny.

A blurry image flashed through Chen Ji's mind: three years later, Sima Jingtian would face a great catastrophe, and the trigger for that disaster... was connected to today's events. A subtle smile curved Chen Ji's lips—excellent move.

choices.memory_label: 暗中布局_窥探司马惊天弱点

choices.description: Stepping forward, attracting Sima Jingtian's attention by playing the 'waste' role, buying time for the Crown Prince to transfer the secret decree.
choices.visible_cost: May expose identity, bringing deadly danger
choices.visible_reward: Win the Crown Prince's loyalty, protect the secret decree
choices.risk_hint: Facing a major power head-on with a waste persona has extremely low success rate

text.content: Just as Chen Ji was about to step forward, Han Lie抢先一步站出来。"老东西！" Han Lie怒吼道，"你敢不敢与我一对一决战！" Sima Jingtian's gaze fell on him, a playful smile emerging: "Interesting, let me show you what true disparity looks like."

choices.memory_label: 牺牲破局_韩烈抢先挺身

text.content: As Sima Jingtian stepped into the void to depart, his steps suddenly halted. Those murky yet profound eyes slowly turned toward the empty space, as if conversing with some invisible existence. His lips barely moved, though no sound emerged, but Chen Ji, by reading his lips, faintly made out several words—"...Chess Game... Begins..."

dialogue.content: (Pupils constricting, heart掀起惊涛骇浪) Who was he conversing with? What did the words "Chess Game" mean? Could it be... even the Eyes of Heavenly Way are merely chess pieces?

text.content: Sima Jingtian's gaze finally swept across the crowd, lingering for a moment in one direction—precisely where Chen Ji stood. That gaze carried an eerie familiarity, as if they had known each other long ago, or as if examining an insignificant ant. A meaningful arc curved at the corner of his mouth before his form transformed into flowing light, vanishing across the northern horizon.

choice.prompt: Sima Jingtian has departed, but the shadows he left behind loom over everyone's heart. What will you do now?

choices.description: The Crown Prince lies unconscious—whatever is written in that secret decree? Must examine it immediately, no time to waste.
choices.visible_cost: May be discovered having secret contact with the Crown Prince
choices.visible_reward: Uncover a corner of the greatest secret regarding imperial succession
choices.risk_hint: If noticed by those with ulterior motives, may invite deadly misfortune
choices.process_label: seize chaos to read secret edict

text.content: Seizing the moment when ministers were in chaos, Chen Ji quietly retreated to a secluded corner, retrieving the secret decree from his sleeve. His fingers trembled slightly—what kind of taboo was even the Eyes of Heavenly Way wary of?

choices.memory_label: 追查密旨_揭开禁忌一角

choices.description: Han Lie stood up for the Crown Prince, only to draw the Law Enforcement Elder's targeting. At this moment his heart must be complex—perhaps an opportunity for recruitment.
choices.visible_reward: Deepen the bond with Han Lie
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie's straightforward personality may mean he won't trust your 'useless' persona

text.content: Chen Ji approached Han Lie, only to find him standing alone beside a collapsed pillar, fists clenched so tight they creaked. Han Lie spun around abruptly, a flash of vulnerability flickering in his eyes: 'Why did you stop me just now?'

Just then, the prince who had been unconscious for so long suddenly let out a weak groan. The imperial physician rushed forward to examine him, watching as the prince's lips slowly parted,吐出 several blurred words: 'Imperial decree... Tianji... cannot be trusted...' Before he could finish speaking, he fell into unconsciousness again. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply — what did the prince mean? Could even the Tianji Record... not be trusted?

dialogue.content: Fingers unconsciously tracing the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve, an unprecedented chill surged through his heart. The forbidden knowledge that even the Eyes of Heavenly Mandate feared... the prince's warning before falling unconscious... the bizarre aura around Sima Jingtian... where do all these clues lead?

text.content: In the ruins of the imperial capital, Chen Ji stood alone in a corner, his gaze deep and unfathomable as an abyss. Today's humiliation, he had recorded it; Sima Jingtian's weakness, he had glimpsed it; and that greater mystery — the terrifying truth that even the Eyes of Heavenly Mandate were merely chess pieces — was slowly revealing its tip of the iceberg to him. He raised his head toward the northern horizon, where an invisible pair of eyes seemed to pierce through the void, quietly watching him.

dialogue.content: Murmuring softly, 'A chess game... is it?' Then let's see, who is the chess piece, and who is the chess player.

text.content: Night fell, and the clamor of the imperial capital gradually subsided. However, beneath this seemingly peaceful night, undercurrents churned — the prince's imperial decree, Sima Jingtian's strangeness, the prince's dying warning, and that无形 gaze that had always watched Chen Ji. All the clues pointed to a chilling possibility: behind the Eyes of Heavenly Mandate existed an even more terrifying being; and the Tianji Record in his hands might from the very beginning have been a chess piece designed for him. Tonight, the imperial capital was destined for no peaceful sleep.
